args.query: expired client certificate mTLS handshake bank partner payments

events.statement: payment-service logs show mTLS handshake failures with bank-partner-api: 'remote error: tls: expired certificate (alert 45); our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z', 171 occurrences, first seen 2026-04-02T12:16:44Z.
A cert-watcher WARN at 11:50:26Z gave 25 minutes notice: client certificate CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal expires at notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z.
bank_api_error_rate jumped from ~0.2% to 50% in the 12:10 bucket and 100% from the 12:20 bucket onward, remaining at 100% through 13:50.
payment_success_rate collapsed from ~99% to ~2.6% in the same 12:10/12:20 buckets and stayed near 2.5% (min 1.44) through 13:50, i.e. roughly 97% of payments failing.
The HTTP error_rate metric (5xx % of requests) stayed flat at ~0.2% across the whole window, never rising above max 0.32 — this is the green dashboard the report mentions.
140 ERROR logs show payments absorbed asynchronously: 'payment <id> marked PENDING_RETRY: mTLS handshake with bank-partner-api rejected', first seen 12:15:27Z.
No code deployments occurred for any service in 2026-04-02T11:00–13:59Z (count 0).
The only config change in the window was payment-service bank.api.timeout_ms raised from 3000 to 5000 at 11:20:00Z, ~55 minutes before onset.
bank-partner-api is an external dependency with has_telemetry=false; there are no config changes recorded for it.
Payment request_rate stayed steady ~100 req/s before and during the incident (min 90.22, max 109.57), so the failure is not a traffic surge.
p99 latency dropped (320ms -> ~140ms) at onset rather than rising — consistent with requests failing fast at handshake instead of hanging.
No WARN/ERROR logs from api-gateway or ledger-db in the window, so upstream edge and shared database were not the source of the failure.

A prior incident HIST-106 (settlement-service, 2025-06-30) had the same signature: 'Client certificate expired; no renewal automation', category credential_expiry, resolution 'Issued new cert; added expiry alert'.
Failures are logged at ERROR in payment-service but the synchronous HTTP path returns success (marked PENDING_RETRY, queued retry), so the 5xx-based error_rate panel cannot see them.
